nativeCases: Binary overwrite and append preserve invalid UTF-8 and null bytes, separate stdout file bytes and last-pipeline exit status

Unlinking the opened pathname retains stderr writes through a surviving hard link without recreating the old name
Oversized command diagnostics remain bounded even when stderr is redirected
